product.title: Private Surf Lessons in Honolulu

description.text: Private surf lessons in Honolulu are taught one-to-one by an instructor with 18 years on the world circuit. Sessions are matched to skill, from first-timers learning the basics to experienced riders working on technique. A surfboard and waterproof gear are provided. The lessons suit most ages and fitness levels, including younger children. The instructor stays with one student, and the surfboard and waterproof gear are part of the Honolulu lesson. Younger children can join when the lesson fits their age and fitness.
